messages:
Alex: :loudspeaker: Quick maintenance notice: planned control-plane patch + failover rehearsal in us-east-1 on 2025-11-20 04:00-05:00 UTC. Expected impact: brief control-plane API latency spikes (~3-8m) during each master restart.
Mina: Will this touch inference nodes or customer traffic?
Alex: No customer dataplane impact expected. Management APIs (deploy, scale, config) may see timeouts. Token issuance unaffected.
Theo: We'll do a sequential master restart with 5m stabilization between restarts. We'll also run a simulated AZ failover after patch to validate routing and KV-cache warmup.
Jordan: Post-rotation we'll execute a lightweight traffic replay to ensure routing fallbacks work. Ill own the replay and validation (p95 < 300ms for control plane calls).
Alex: PD suppression + temporary SLO-burn rule will be active for the window (+30% burn tolerance for 1h). pagerduty-bot will post suppression.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: control-plane-fix v2.16 at 2025-11-20T04:10:00Z (infra).
pagerduty-bot: PD suppression active: control-plane-maint-us-east 2025-11-20T04:00:00Z -> 2025-11-20T05:00:00Z.
Mina: Can we get the short abort criteria?
Alex: Abort if any of: >10% sustained 5xx for >5m, leader-election flaps >2 in 10m, or autoscaler fails to scale during smoke. If abort -> stop further restarts and restore previous apiserver.
Theo: Preflight at T-30: etcd health, backups (<6h), no ongoing upgrades. I'll post confirmation at T-20.
Jordan: Observability: Grafana apiserver: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/apiserver-us-east, Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/q?query=us-east+apiserver
Alex: We'll open ephemeral incident channel #incidents/maint-us-east-2025-11-20 and post 10m updates. Treat this as the official notice unless we reschedule. :white_check_mark:
